Apps / add

Add an app

An app comes from its deploy artifact: the package your pipeline publishes to the registry. shelf reads it, generates the secrets it declares, and keeps the app on that tag from then on.

Connections

Connections are defined once, on the connections page, and chosen here. With a registry connection, the form offers the deploy artifacts and tags of its user. With a Cloudflare connection, the app gets a tunnel of its own in that account and a DNS record in its zone. Without one, it gets a quick tunnel: a random address that needs no account and no domain, but changes whenever the tunnel restarts, and is meant for trying things out.

Domain

Empty, it answers at <app>-dev.example.com, with its name in place of <app>. To reach it from the internet, the domain has to be a zone of the Cloudflare connection's account.
